last_summary: The evidence identifies ingredient additions and marinades but not their chemical or functional roles: v1 shows unidentified paste/powder and shaker contents, v2 shows garlic/onion/liquid marinade with no visible tenderizer label, v3 shows sugar/white paste and unidentified dark liquid, and v4 shows Mirin/soy/red powder/minced yellow ingredient. Competing interpretations remain: each could be seasoning, sweetener, sauce, or fruit/enzyme tenderizer, so a unique tenderizing agent cannot yet be established.
